function.arguments: {"observation": "The raw conversion rate for `email` (38.8%) is higher than for `paid_search` (31.3%), but this difference is confounded by customer_segment. The email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal and returning customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. When we compare within each segment, email performs *worse* than paid_search in all three segments: loyalty (-18.6%), new (-16.6%), and returning (-5.4%).", "implication": "The question 'Was the campaign successful?' cannot be answered by comparing raw conversion rates between channels. function.name: note_finding
